title: Three Years and One Short Staff
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：mercy　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mercy 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the elder ① showed the mercy that no youth in the village would have noted, and he said the showing was the whole of the year. The ② mercy, meaning the pity itself and not the staff, ran three years and stayed unnoted in the book; mercy, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ bit of mercy in that village had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ mercy at the far gate, meaning the hope they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Mercy, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the elder said the noting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the mercy was the whole of the matter, meaning the kindness and not the pity. The ⑥ mercy, meaning the kindness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; mercy, he said, is either something you show or the only word that means both pity and a kindness. He said the kindness is the part they remember.

By 1985 the ⑦ mercy had become a line in a memoir, and the memoir had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ mercy of the whole thing, the elder wrote in November, was one village and three years of noting; mercy, he said, is either the hope at the far gate or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ mercy I remember is the mercy noted in the memoir, which closed in 1987 and is still noted as the quietest in the village. ⑩ Mercy, my mother said in 1989, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all mercy, she said, is a kindness that has agreed to look like pity. She said the kindness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 仁慈；怜悯（指村子里每一点旁边的那一点）
B. n. 仁慈；怜悯（指那份仁慈本身，与短短的拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：show the mercy 施这一份仁慈
D. n. 仁慈；怜悯（指留给孩子们守着的那一个）
E. n. 仁慈之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的仁慈之事）
F. n. 仁慈；怜悯（指回忆录里写到、被记下的那一份）
G. n. 仁慈、慈悲（指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 慈悲（抽象总称，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: showed the mercy that no youth in the village would have noted
The mercy, meaning the pity itself and not the staff
Every bit of mercy in that village
the mercy at the far gate
the mercy was the whole of the matter
the mercy had become a line in a memoir
The mercy of the whole thing

answers.why: show the mercy 意为“施这一份仁慈”，1980 年那位长者把村子里没有一位后生肯记下的一份仁慈做了一遍。
mercy 意为“仁慈；怜悯”，指那份仁慈本身而不是短短的拐杖，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记下。
mercy 意为“仁慈；怜悯”，指村子里每一点旁边的那一点，每一点旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
mercy 意为“仁慈；怜悯”，指最远那道村口的留给孩子们守着的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
mercy 意为“仁慈、慈悲”，指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份慈悲就是那件事的全部。
mercy 意为“慈悲”，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份仁慈，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
mercy 意为“仁慈；怜悯”，指回忆录里写到、被记下的那一份，到 1985 年这一份成了回忆录里的一行。
mercy 意为“仁慈之事”，长者十一月写道，整件事的仁慈之事是一处村子和三个年头的记下。
mercy 意为“仁慈；怜悯”，我记得的是回忆录里记下过的那一份，1987 年想通了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一份。
mercy 为抽象总称，母亲 1989 年说，仁慈是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的仁慈。
